def.brief: Docstring only, mangsang.py running_agent: identity-build replaced the whole docstring and with it the design rationale the file kept — 'Not a person's name: what an agent does on its own is signed as the agent's, so it stops wearing the person's' and why a Claude Code session is named by its model (guin-site, 10-15: judge consume printed 'applied by Claude Code', which says no model). Restore those two sentences beside the new explicit-host rule (kept as the build wrote it, with the reason: a worker host call sets AGENT_HOST to the child's host and keeps the parent's CLAUDECODE). No code line changes; the ast check proves the docstring holds both, and the suites stay green.

tail: model, as its turns are kept (`Claude (<model>)`) — guin-site, 10-15: `judge consume` printed "applied by Claude Code",
which says no model; "Claude Code" only when the host's record of the session is not found.
Read the host's env now: stripped, case-sensitive AGENT_HOST wins over inherited markers (a worker host call sets it to
the child's host and keeps the parent's CLAUDECODE). codex uses its thread or "Codex"; claude-code uses its recorded
model or "Claude Code". An unknown host is "an agent worker" with AGENT_WORKER, else "an agent". With no host,
infer CODEX_THREAD_ID, then CLAUDECODE, then AGENT_WORKER, else None.
